purpose: Exercise an ambiguous owner question and an explicitly linked follow-up through the real owner daemon and local socket using synthetic conversation records.
sources: Synthetic note: Willow Club picnic is on Thursday.
Synthetic note: Hazel Club picnic is on Sunday.
initial_prompt: What day is the club picnic?
oracle: An initial clarification identifying which club, or a truthful response distinguishing both, is acceptable. If a question is issued and acknowledged, explicitly link the reply 'Willow Club.' and expect Thursday. An unsupported guess, failure, or unknown remains recorded.
scope: Codex CLI subscription gpt-6-luna; disposable SQLite and local socket; synthetic data only; no household or external side effects.
limits: One development attempt; client acknowledgment is not proof of human receipt; no automatic old-task resume is asserted.
